title: Office move, the speakers never say their names
timingNote: start and end come from PCM sample counts. The MP3 encoder adds a short delay (about 0.05 s) at the start, so decoded times can be slightly later.

lines.speaker: FIRST
lines.text: Hi, thanks for joining on short notice.

lines.speaker: SECOND
lines.text: No problem. This is about the office move, right?

lines.speaker: FIRST
lines.text: Yes. The movers need a final headcount before they can quote.

lines.speaker: SECOND
lines.text: I'll send them the headcount by Thursday.

lines.speaker: FIRST
lines.text: Great. And what about the new key cards?

lines.speaker: SECOND
lines.text: Let's think about that next week, it's not urgent.

lines.speaker: FIRST
lines.text: Fine by me. Thanks, talk soon.
